title: formula lint admits a read of a field the related object does not declare; the read then nulls every formula through that lookup, valid siblings included
body:
Filed by the `repo:cloud#2` seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#24145, session `session_01Cbdek8SKSHxddGqTPZXdqX`) from the objectstack-ai/cloud#2925 dev report (cloud PR #3047, report `6256739687`), out-of-scope finding 1 (class c + a, reach: public HTTP door). ⛔ Not a claim. Measured on a local stack at cloud's framework pin `ec749fbb44b5`.

## What was measured

1. `PUT /api/v1/meta/object` answers **200** for a formula that reads `record.book.name`, although `pq_book` declares no `name` field.
2. `GET /api/v1/data` then reads that formula `null` on every row. A VALID sibling formula on the same object, `joinNonEmpty([record.book.title, record.reader.reader_name], ' · ')`, also reads `null` in the same read.
3. **Control:** `?fields=title` (the valid formula alone) reads 「月亮与六便士 · 赵明轩」.
4. The runtime's own WARN says a re-save "refuses it with a located message", but the re-save answered 200.

## Why it matters

The same shape as objectstack-ai/objectstack#24197 (closed) one level in: a formula that passes validation and reads null. Here one bad read also blanks the good ones. An AI writing a record title (ADR-0079 D3) guesses the target's field name, and the whole title family goes blank with no refusal.

- **Named producer:** the cloud AI builder. PR #3047 guards its own path (`titleFormulaGaps`). Every other author (Studio, `create_metadata`, a package) still gets the 200.
- **Seam:** spec object field formula expression → runtime objectql `resolveFormulaRelated` (the one-hop read) + lint `validate-expressions.ts` `judgeFieldFormula`, which admits it.

## Target

- A formula reading a field its lookup's target does not declare is refused at save, with the field and the target named.
- One formula's failed read does not null its siblings.

Dedupe words: formula undeclared related field, one-hop formula sibling null, traversal lint related field existence, formula hop unknown column.
